sections.title: 引言
sections.original: Archery accuracy relies heavily on the aiming and follow-through phases, during which factors such as muscle activation, postural control, and drawing arm movement play key roles. This study aims to assess whether these performance determinants in high-level archery are consistent across athletes or reflect individual-specific strategies.
sections.text: 射箭的精准度很大程度上取决于瞄准和随动阶段。肌肉激活、姿势控制和拉弦臂动作等因素在这些阶段起着关键作用。本研究旨在评估，高水平射箭的这些表现决定因素在不同运动员之间是否一致，还是体现了各自的策略。

sections.title: 方法
sections.original: Eight top-level French archers (4 women, 4 men) shot eight rounds of nine arrows at a 70 m target, using their personal equipment in a competition-like outdoor setting. Data on neuromuscular activity, postural control, body segment configuration and temporal strategies were collected during the aiming and follow-through phases. Arrow scores were grouped into high (10), mid (9), and low (≤8) for analysis.
sections.text: 8 名法国高水平射箭运动员（4 女、4 男）在模拟比赛的户外环境中使用自己的器材，向 70 米外的靶射了 8 组，每组 9 支箭。研究人员在瞄准和随动阶段采集神经肌肉活动、姿势控制、身体节段构型和时间策略的数据。分析时将单箭得分分为高（10 环）、中（9 环）和低（≤8 环）三组。

sections.title: 结果
sections.original: At the group level, several muscles and postural control parameters were associated with performance during the aiming phase (seven muscles, three postural parameters, and mechanical clicker reaction time) and the follow-through phase (four muscles and three postural parameters). At the individual level, two parameters during aiming (medial deltoid activity on the bow side and aiming duration) and two parameters during the follow-through phase (upper trapezius activity on the drawing side and surface of center of pressure displacement) were identified as individual strategies.
sections.text: 在组别层面，瞄准阶段的多项指标（涉及 7 块肌肉、3 项姿势控制参数及机械响片反应时间）和随动阶段的多项指标（涉及 4 块肌肉和 3 项姿势控制参数）与表现相关。在个体层面，瞄准阶段的两个参数（持弓侧三角肌中束活动和瞄准时长），以及随动阶段的两个参数（拉弦侧斜方肌上束活动和压力中心位移面积）被识别为个体策略。

sections.title: 讨论
sections.original: These findings highlight both shared performance determinants and individualized strategies among elite archers, emphasizing that while technical approaches vary, certain biomechanical patterns remain crucial for optimal performance.
sections.text: 这些发现表明，高水平射手既有共同的表现决定因素，也有个体化策略。尽管采用的技术方式各不相同，某些生物力学模式对达到最佳表现仍然至关重要。

title: 论文摘要 · 原文与译文
credit: © 2026 Gao、Hong、Hou、Gao、Han 和 Li · Frontiers in Physiology 17:1880932。弓行记将原文摘要译为中文。

sections.title: 目的
sections.original: Sport-specific training may reshape athletes’ executive function and manual fine-motor control in a discipline-specific manner, affecting the efficiency of sensorimotor-cognitive coupling. Open-skill and closed-skill sports differ in environmental uncertainty and movement stability demands, but direct comparisons of hand dexterity, inhibitory control, and their interrelations across these sport types are limited.
sections.text: 专项训练可能以项目特有的方式重塑运动员的执行功能和手部精细运动控制，进而影响感觉运动与认知的耦合效率。开放式技能项目和闭锁式技能项目在环境不确定性和动作稳定性要求方面有所不同，但直接比较这两类项目中手部灵巧性、抑制控制及二者关系的研究仍然有限。

sections.title: 方法
sections.original: In this cross-sectional observational study, 114 participants (17 females, 97 males; mean age 20.07 ± 1.64 years) were recruited into three groups: Basketball athletes (BA), Archery athletes (AA), and Sedentary controls (SC). Under a unified testing protocol, participants completed the Purdue Pegboard Test (PPT), Grooved Pegboard Test (GPT), Handgrip strength assessment, the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), and the Stroop Color-Word (SCW) Test to evaluate unilateral and bilateral fine manual dexterity, hand strength, global cognition, and inhibitory control.
sections.text: 这项横断面观察研究招募了 114 名受试者（17 名女性、97 名男性，平均年龄 20.07 ± 1.64 岁），分为篮球运动员组（BA）、射箭运动员组（AA）和久坐对照组（SC）。按照统一的测试流程，受试者完成普渡插板测验（PPT）、沟槽插板测验（GPT）、握力测试、蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）和 Stroop 色词测验（SCW），用于评估单手和双手的精细灵巧性、手部力量、总体认知和抑制控制。

sections.title: 结果
sections.original: AA outperformed both BA and SC on fine-motor tasks (PPT and GPT; all p < 0.05; d = 0.76–0.96 vs. SC). BA showed significantly greater grip strength and higher MoCA total scores than AA and SC (all p < 0.05; grip strength d = 0.95 and MoCA d = 0.83 vs. SC). Both athletic groups exceeded SC on PPT, GPT, and grip strength measures (all p < 0.05). On Stroop measures, BA showed higher word-reading completion than SC and AA, whereas AA scored lower than both SC and BA under the color-naming and color-word interference conditions (all p < 0.05); error counts did not differ between groups.
sections.text: AA 在精细运动任务上的表现优于 BA 和 SC（PPT 和 GPT，均为 p < 0.05，与 SC 相比 d = 0.76–0.96）。BA 的握力和 MoCA 总分均显著高于 AA 和 SC（均为 p < 0.05，与 SC 相比，握力 d = 0.95，MoCA d = 0.83）。两个运动员组的 PPT、GPT 和握力指标均优于 SC（均为 p < 0.05）。在 Stroop 测验中，BA 的词语阅读完成量高于 SC 和 AA。在颜色命名和色词干扰条件下，AA 的得分低于 SC 和 BA（均为 p < 0.05）。各组的错误次数无差异。

sections.title: 结论
sections.original: Findings indicate sport-specific adaptations: archery training is associated with superior fine motor control and movement stability, whereas basketball training is linked to enhanced neuromuscular strength and higher global cognitive screening scores (MoCA), together with better performance on a Stroop interference task. These specialization effects suggest that inter-sport assessments and training programs should account for discipline characteristics and integrate targeted strength and cognitive training to promote more balanced athlete development. Given the cross-sectional design, these associations cannot establish causality, as self-selection into specific sports cannot be distinguished from training-induced adaptation; the sex-imbalanced sample (97 males, 17 females) further limits generalizability. Longitudinal or intervention studies are warranted.
sections.text: 研究结果表明存在项目特异性适应。射箭训练与更好的精细运动控制和动作稳定性有关。篮球训练则与更强的神经肌肉力量、更高的总体认知筛查得分（MoCA），以及更好的 Stroop 干扰任务表现有关。这些专项化效应提示，跨项目的评估和训练计划应考虑各项目的特点，并纳入有针对性的力量与认知训练，以促进运动员更均衡的发展。鉴于本研究采用横断面设计，这些关联无法确立因果关系，因为无法区分参与者主动选择特定运动项目与训练诱发的适应。样本的性别比例失衡（97 名男性、17 名女性）也进一步限制了结果的可推广性。仍需开展纵向研究或干预研究。
